normative_statement: Este grafo fija la genealogía matemática APP→TRIT→TPK por objetos, tipos y composiciones. Los propietarios documentales se registran sólo como evidencia y procedencia; ningún PDF define por sí mismo la matemática.
global_causal_chain: APP: soporte único con hojas aditiva y multiplicativa
TRIT: orientación ternaria, carry y régimen
TPK: selección, transporte, actualización, memoria y retorno

object_distinctions.rule: No identificar emisiones decimales, palabras ternarias visibles y fibra ambiente. Ψ6 tiene imagen visible en un ambiente mayor y debe conservar procedencia.

Son objetos de tipos distintos. R12 es un mapa de registro; C12 es el grupo cíclico; Θ108 es un registro/calendario; Γ108 es una acción o iterado. La igualdad de cardinales o periodos no autoriza su identificación.
−1/12 es un defecto normalizado; 12:−1 es un peso firmado mínimo de la familia 4a−3b=45. No son el mismo objeto.
M_ph:D9→TRIT es una función. m_ph=(M_ph(1),…,M_ph(9))=(1,−1,0)^3 es su vector de valores en la carta canónica 1,…,9.

global_invariants.statement: Toda salida nace de la composición APP→TRIT→TPK; ningún objeto convencional selecciona retrospectivamente entradas, coeficientes o estados.
g(K+9)=g(K) expresa retorno de fase; en general B_(K+9)≠B_K y la memoria/profundidad aumenta.
sp, sol, gau, coh y det son cinco construcciones consustanciales del mismo continuo y emergen conjuntamente del mismo estado enriquecido; nunca son cinco ramas independientes.
π, e, φ, α, valores metrológicos, masas, CODATA, Witt, Barbero o resultados convencionales no pueden intervenir como entradas del generador que los publica.
M_ph selecciona hoja/fase; T_d transporta cardinalmente. MOV3 nunca es alias de T_d; MOF3 es una transcripción rechazada, no una denominación matemática.
K_ph es transferencia/renovación posterior sobre emisiones ya construidas; no es generador de π/e/φ, selector de B10 ni sucesor determinista del estado TPK.

residence_policy.rule: Cada nodo reside semánticamente en este grafo. Sus evidence_refs enlazan propietarios materiales activos o inactivos únicamente como prueba y procedencia; no transfieren autoridad normativa al documento citado.

joint_constant_output_contract.declared_scope: The same APP→TRIT→TPK enriched state precedes the joint discrete continuum, its five inseparable constructions, the terminal mathematical problems treated by the corpus, and the typed HMT–MD derivations of the published catalog of physical constants and masses.

gate_requirements: Exactly 34 nodes with canonical_index 1..34, each unique, plus exactly M_PH, SEL_T, TRA_T, UPD_T and U_T.

Every node must declare ontological_class, causal_rank, domain, codomain, action, output, conserved_fields, forgotten_fields, dependencies, negative_control, provenance, strength and activation_status.
Presence of a symbol is insufficient: ACTIVE_TYPED_ALIAS_ONLY fails a definition-body gate until a full active definition and proof localizer are supplied.

Every typed edge must unify the source output type with the target input contract; structures, alphabets, categories and inverse-limit objects cannot be applied as maps without an explicit reader or classifier.
Dependency cycles are forbidden except declared dynamical iteration through U_T→X_TPK^enr, which must certify nondecreasing memory or depth.
M_PH must be a function and m_ph its value vector; MOV3 must never alias T_d, and MOF3 is rejected as a transcription error.
U_T must be typed exactly as Upd_t∘Tra_t∘Sel_t; the untyped shorthand Rec∘Mem∘T∘M_ph is rejected.
K_PH must have posterior-emission dependencies and must never carry generator status.
The gate must distinguish U6=468, W6=243 and F3^6=729.
The gate must distinguish R12, C12, Θ108 and Γ108 by ontological class and domain/codomain.
Γ9 requires phase_return=true, state_reset=false and an explicit memory/depth advance.

The nonadic generation certificate must expose the full chain 104976→468→243⊂729 and w6→w12→w18→w24→w30→R36→G9, together with 396 levels, 2376 trits, 43 complete turns, 387 equal-phase pairs and the five π regions.

The nonadic image contract must expose π_HMT, e_HMT, φ_HMT and α_HMT as its minimum correlated core under one joint_generation_id while remaining open to further typed composite and specular publications. It must preserve the internal partial order x_term→(P,E,PHI), x_term→U12_sgn↔K, (P,E,PHI,K,c13)→C12→(A,C)→ALPHA_HMT. Only external or conventional PI_E_PHI→ALPHA_HMT is forbidden.
K_ph must certify K_ph^9|_r=E_+E_× as a posterior two-sheet renewal and must never be promoted to Γ9 or to the coinductive generator.
R12 must certify the non-split exact sequence 0→C12→C108→C9→0, its carry cocycle and the distinction between observable calendar return and enriched-state return.
The TPK-first 90/120 construction must remain recorded as recovered but inactive until its owner body is activated; later hexad–octad or exceptional realizations cannot substitute it.
−1/12 and 12:−1 require different IDs, constructions and types.
sp, sol, gau, coh and det must be generated jointly from U_T and X_χ and must never be accepted as five independent branches.
No target value, metrological table, CODATA, Witt object, Barbero value or particle mass may occur upstream of its HMT output.
Owner paths are evidentiary and non-normative: validity depends on the typed graph and proof, not on the existence of a PDF.
